tagline: The gate opens before you reach it
brief: An Android app that rings your call-to-open gate automatically when you drive up to, or leave, your parking spot. It should feel effortless, calm and reliable: a quiet helper, not a security product.
criteria: Success: avoids the category clichés (house, key, shield, pin, handset), reads at 16 px as a launcher icon and favicon, works in one colour, and ties calling and opening together.

concepts.name: Lift
concepts.idea: The gate's lifting arm drawn as rising signal bars around one pivot: calling and opening in a single shape.
rationale: Amber dot = you and the call; green bars = the arm rising, one step at a time
Clean 0/30/60 degree geometry with one bar width and round caps, echoed in the custom wordmark
Dedicated small-size cut keeps the gaps open for favicons and notifications

recommendation: Lift: ownable in a category of keys and shields, friendly, and it works from a 16 px status-bar icon up to the website hero.
next_steps: Ship the adaptive launcher icon and notification icon in the next release
Use the horizontal lockup on the website and README
Trademark search before any wider distribution
